sentences.1: Controllers must conduct a review to assess if processing complies with the data protection impact assessment when there is a change in the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.10: You may need to repeat it if there is a substantial change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of your processing.
sentences.2: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.3: It is important to reevaluate the DPIA when there is a change of the risk represented by the processing operation.
sentences.4: A DPIA must be kept under review and may need to be repeated if there is a substantial change to the nature, scope, context, or purposes of processing.
sentences.5: A DPIA should be reevaluated when there is a change in the risk represented by the processing operation due to evolution of technology, use of data for different purposes, or organizational context changes.
sentences.6: DPIAs should be kept under review and revisited when necessary.
sentences.7: We keep our DPIAs under review and revisit them when necessary.
sentences.8: A DPIA is an ongoing process for managing risks, not a one-time exercise, and must be reevaluated when the risk represented by the processing operation changes.
sentences.9: You need to keep your DPIA under review.
